tasks.description: Plans dependency updates for each service from lockfiles, requirement pins and a latest-version list, following the update policy. Use when asked for an update plan for a repository's dependencies.
tasks.intent: Plan per-service dependency updates with bump size and policy action.

tasks.description: Matches resolved dependency versions against a local advisory list and ranks the hits by severity. Use when asked which dependencies are affected by known advisories.
tasks.intent: Match installed dependency versions against the local advisory list.

tasks.description: Groups pending dependency updates into batches sized by the update policy, with security fixes first. Use when asked to group dependency updates into batches for pull requests.
tasks.intent: Group pending updates into policy-sized batches, security fixes first.
